c: While Heir of Fate (XIX) is active, defeating enemies with
Fire damage causes them to drop
Scorched Souls, pickups which increase
and

. While individually these bonuses are miniscule, the Scorched Souls gathered can quickly increase a player's stats. There is also a 200-250 pickup limit for Scorched Souls that can be on the stage at any point. Whenever the player collected a Scorched Soul, a fiery explosion will occur around them, damaging enemies in its radius.
The stats provided by
Scorched Souls are based on the base
Experience value of the enemy that dropped it. The stat bonuses provided by a Scorched Soul are:
= 0.1 * Base XP Value
= 0.01% * Base XP Value
For example, a
Skelegem, with a Base XP of 3, will drop a Scorched Soul that gives +0.3 Max Health and +0.03% Might.
Additionally, Heir of Fate will trigger an HP-Critical
when the character's Health hits 20%. This ability recovers once the character is healed back to full Max Health.
Weapons that can deal Fire damage will be marked with an indicator on the right side of their selection icon when the character levels up.
